name: プロデューサー
text:
円香、本番でいい反応もらってたよな
テンパリングで、筋がいいって
trans:
Hey Madoka, I heard that you did really well on the
actual recording. They were really impressed by
your chocolate tempering skills.

name: 円香
text: たまたま上手くいっただけ
trans: It just happened to turn out well, that's all.

name: プロデューサー
text:
はは、さすがだな
てっきり練習とかしたのかと
trans:
Haha, I thought you'd say that. And here I was sure
that you had practiced beforehand or something.
